claims.statement: The target monitor was current, its incident was active, all five monitored Space Manager sections failed, and the hierarchy sweep covered the target location.
Overview reported location_selection_mismatch; the other monitored sections reported location_state_null.
Recorded requests completed successfully, a WebSocket upgraded and exchanged frames, and one API/UI count matched exactly.
claims.caveat: Schema validity was not evaluated. These facts narrow the fault domain but do not prove every backend dependency healthy.

claims.statement: A shared client-side location-state selection-commit defect is the most evidence-supported root cause.
claims.caveat: This is not formal causal proof; source instrumentation and a controlled intervention remain required.

claims.statement: The local monitor baseline passed 140 tests plus 27 subtests, and the dashboard baseline passed 32 tests plus 2 subtests on Python 3.11.
claims.caveat: Baseline tests validate monitoring code, not repair of the live product incident.

repairAndRecheck.repairBoundary: Commit selected location to one shared client store and prevent silent reversion.
repairAndRecheck.publicationGate: All five sections and nested views must receive non-null location state, exact API/UI checks must agree, and the live monitor must replay cleanly.
